pages.text: The Matter Beamer sends material items to a $(l:rftoolsbase:machines/spawner)Spawner$(/l). It has one input slot, uses FE while active, and beams items only when the linked spawner can use them.

pages.title: Linking
pages.text: Use a wrench on the Matter Beamer, then use the wrench on the target Spawner. Wrenching the selected beamer again clears the destination.

pages.title: Operation
pages.text: Give the beamer a redstone signal and insert materials needed by the spawner recipe. $(5)Infusing$() sends more items per pulse and reduces FE cost.
